Probably the test originally only needed some imports: ValidationContext, SchemaValidatorsConfig, PathType, JsonNodePath, JsonNodePathJsonPointer, JsonNodePathLegacy, JsonNodePathJsonPath, BaseJsonValidator, etc.

We need to simplify imports: remove all those huge chain imports. Also need Mockito imports; but we can avoid using Mockito by not using @Mock and just instantiate objects directly. Simpler: remove Mockito usage entirely. Use real ValidationContext and ConfigStub.

Also BaseJsonValidator constructor signature: need to find correct constructor. Let's inspect typical BaseJsonValidator in networknt schema library. I recall BaseJsonValidator has a protected constructor with many arguments: SchemaLocation schemaLocation, JsonNodePath evaluationPath, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parentSchema, ValidatorTypeCode validatorType, ValidationContext validationContext, boolean suppressSubSchemaRetrieval. Might be something like that. Let's search memory: In networknt json-schema-validator, BaseJsonValidator extends JsonValidator. The constructor: protected BaseJsonValidator(SchemaLocation schemaLocation, JsonNodePath evaluationPath, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parentSchema, ValidatorTypeCode validatorType, ValidationContext validationContext, boolean suppressSubSchemaRetrieval). Another overload includes errorMessageType etc.

Simplify: we can create a subclass that calls super with minimal required arguments. Use null where allowed. Need to supply a ValidationContext (vc). Also need a SchemaLocation maybe null accepted? Let's check source quickly from memory: In version 1.0.71, BaseJsonValidator has constructors:

protected BaseJsonValidator(SchemaLocation schemaLocation, JsonNodePath evaluationPath, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parentSchema, ValidatorTypeCode validatorType, ValidationContext validationContext, boolean suppressSubSchemaRetrieval) { ... }

Also another: protected BaseJsonValidator(SchemaLocation schemaLocation, JsonNodePath evaluationPath, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parentSchema, ErrorMessageType errorMessageType, Keyword keyword, ValidationContext validationContext, boolean suppressSubSchemaRetrieval) { ... }

Thus we need to import relevant classes: SchemaLocation, JsonNodePath, JsonNode, JsonSchema, ValidatorTypeCode, ErrorMessageType, Keyword maybe.

But we can simply use the first constructor with nulls for many arguments.

Thus ConcreteValidator extends BaseJsonValidator and implements abstract method validate(ExecutionContext, JsonNode, JsonNode, JsonNodePath) returning Set<ValidationMessage>. Actually JsonValidator.validate returns Set<ValidationMessage>. In BaseJsonValidator, abstract method maybe: public abstract Set<ValidationMessage> validate(ExecutionContext executionContext, JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, JsonNodePath at). So need to implement returning empty set.

Thus modify ConcreteValidator.validate to return Collections.emptySet().

Also need to import ExecutionContext, JsonNode, JsonNodePath, Set, Collections.

Now atRoot method is protected in BaseJsonValidator returning JsonNodePath. We expose via invokeAtRoot.

Now need imports for JsonNodePathJsonPointer etc. Those are classes in library: com.networknt.schema.JsonNodePathJsonPointer, JsonNodePathLegacy, JsonNodePathJsonPath. Import them.

Also PathType enum import: com.networknt.schema.PathType.

Also ValidationContext, SchemaValidatorsConfig, JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory.

We need to create ValidationContext with appropriate constructor. In library, ValidationContext has a constructor ValidationContext(JsonMetaSchema metaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory factory, SchemaValidatorsConfig config). So we need to pass JsonMetaSchema.getV7() and JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(VersionFlag.V7?) Actually getInstance method requires VersionFlag. In recent versions, JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance() takes no args? The error shows getInstance(VersionFlag) required. So we need to pass VersionFlag.V7. Import com.networknt.schema.VersionFlag.

Thus ValidationContext vc = new ValidationContext(JsonMetaSchema.getV7(), JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(VersionFlag.V7), cfg);

Now fix imports.

Remove Mockito imports and annotations. No need for @Mock fields. We'll just not use those fields.

Simplify test class: remove @Mock fields, ValidationContextStub, ConfigStub can stay.

But ConfigStub extends SchemaValidatorsConfig and overrides getPathType.

Now adjust test methods: they create ConfigStub and ValidationContext as above.

Now adjust atRootThrowsWhenValidationContextIsNull: ConcreteValidator nullContextValidator = new ConcreteValidator(null); This will cause super call with null validationContext; atRoot should throw NPE. That's fine.

Now adjust imports accordingly.

Now produce corrected code.
